bootstrap.resampling_unit: users, then complete trajectory four-ratio vectors within users

parameter_rationale.ablation: The ablation changes only the distance input: the full method averages squared cell distance over 32 aligned states, whereas the ablation uses the final aligned state. Grid construction, personal candidates, Gaussian weighting, top-10 truncation, destination-region mass aggregation, tie handling, and output mapping are identical.
parameter_rationale.configuration: All grid values are the discovery-selected settings frozen before evaluation of the 37-user cohort; no ablation result selects or changes a parameter.
parameter_rationale.bootstrap: Ten thousand paired hierarchical replicates match the primary analysis scale. Complete four-ratio trajectory vectors are resampled to preserve dependence between observation stages, and the exact user and within-user case draws are saved.
parameter_rationale.secondary_contrast: Geometric-prefix versus current-position retrieval is recomputed under the same saved resamples so that its repeated interval is numerically identical throughout the article.
